name: B10-0479/2025 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION seeking an opinion from the Court of Justice on the compatibility with the Treaties of the proposed Agreement on Digital Trade between the European Union and the Republic of Singapore
part_text:
The European Parliament is worried about a new digital trade deal between the EU and Singapore. It asks the EU Court of Justice to check whether the deal fits EU law. Two concerns stand out: the deal may not protect people's privacy and personal data well enough, and its rules on access to software code may stop the EU from policing algorithms and artificial intelligence. The Parliament is not changing the deal itself; it is requesting a legal opinion.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the EU Court of Justice to review the deal.
- **Who it affects:** People in the EU whose data and privacy are at stake, and EU regulators.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the request to the Court; the Court gives its opinion.
